QUOTE: Channel deleted websocket event ... Only stores `delete_at`; the user stays a member | If viewing that channel, kicks the user out with the `CHANNEL_ARCHIVED` event. Then removes the current user from the channel locally. | Archive a channel ... Sets `delete_at` locally to now | Removes the current user from the channel locally
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The table states that when the gate is off, the user is removed from the channel (and kicked out if currently viewing it), and that when it is on, only `delete_at` is set and the user stays a member.
